ValidationRule.description: Los campos Approved by PM?, Approved by Sales Manager?, Signed by the client? solo se pueden completar en la Etapa Sent For Aproval
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISNEW(), /* Se está creando un nuevo registro */ OR( NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Aprobado_por_Subgerente_de_Ventas__c))), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Firmado__c))), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Aprobado_por_PM__c))) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage:
Los campos Approved by PM?, Approved by SM?, Signed by the client? solo se pueden completar en la Etapa Sent For Aproval.
The fields Approved by PM?, Approved by SM?, Signed by the client? can only be filled out in the Sent For Approval stage.
